/browser Open https://bos.pro and inspect the website as a QA engineer.

Look for one reproducible UI or functional bug.
Do not modify any code or submit any forms.
Check the page carefully, reproduce the issue if possible,
and report:
1. The exact page and location of the bug.
2. Steps to reproduce it.
3. Expected behavior.
4. Actual behavior.
5. Evidence, such as a screenshot.

Do not report assumptions as confirmed bugs.
